query: What review signals predict negative Amazon product satisfaction?

per_column.name: neg_word_count
per_column.rationale: Count of negative lexicon words in the review text; derived from content, not from the label, and plausibly correlated with negative satisfaction. Legitimate predictor.

per_column.name: pos_word_count
per_column.rationale: Count of positive lexicon words; independent of the label and carries signal about polarity. Valid predictor.

per_column.name: neg_phrase_count
per_column.rationale: Count of negative multi-word phrases; a text-derived feature that plausibly signals dissatisfaction without restating the label.

per_column.name: negated_pos_count
per_column.rationale: Counts negated positive expressions (e.g., 'not good'), a nuanced text feature that captures polarity flips; legitimate and non-trivial predictor.

per_column.name: intensified_neg_count
per_column.rationale: Counts intensified negatives (e.g., 'very bad'); text-derived, plausibly predictive of stronger dissatisfaction, not a restatement of label.

per_column.name: sentiment_ratio
per_column.rationale: Continuous net-sentiment score computed from text lexicon; an external feature that correlates with, but does not deterministically define, the label. Valid predictor (mild proxy risk but still a computed feature, not the label).

per_column.name: exclamation_count
per_column.rationale: Stylistic feature (exclamation marks) that can carry emotional-intensity signal; independent of label. Weak but legitimate predictor.

per_column.name: caps_word_count
per_column.rationale: All-caps word count captures emphasis/emotion; a style feature outside the label that may carry signal. Legitimate.

per_column.name: question_count
per_column.rationale: Count of questions may reflect confusion/complaint; a text-style feature independent of the label. Weak but legitimate predictor.

per_column.name: short_title_flag
per_column.rationale: Title-length flag; a structural feature outside the label with possible weak signal. Legitimate though weak.

per_column.name: composite_neg_score
per_column.rationale: Aggregate of the other negativity signals; a computed feature from text, not the label. It is somewhat redundant with its components but still a valid predictor, not leakage.

judge.rationale: All added columns are computed from the review text/title (content, title), not from label_pos, so none leak or restate the focus. The set goes well beyond mechanical length/token counts: it includes polarity lexicons, negation handling, intensification, and net-sentiment ratio, which are genuinely predictive of satisfaction. There is notable internal redundancy (composite_neg_score aggregates several others; neg/pos counts overlap with sentiment_ratio), and some style features (exclamation, caps, questions, short-title) are weak, so incremental leverage is high but not maximal. sentiment_ratio approaches a proxy for the label but remains a computed feature rather than a component of it. Strong, coherent predictive feature set.
